purpose: Focused Windows acceptance for the same committed artifacts and expected snapshots after Linux regeneration, without a full second workspace matrix.
native_hash_qualification: TreeShootId is now derived from deterministic source seeds before float geometry; however tree_source_geometry_hash still hashes branch start/end/radius f32 bits and leaf petiole/centre/length/width f32 bits. Only identity itself is now lossless u64 input. This establishes stable identity, not bitexact cross-platform geometry or prepared-cache compatibility. Source review does not establish either a current Windows cache failure or portability success.

existing_filters.contract: Three-species full/sparse geometry budgets plus byte/order-invariant sparse meshes.
Actual shared native hazel render geometry must fit committed hull/bounds, count and hull tolerance; export env flag must be absent.

Actual seed42 oak source finite geometry and terminal membership; alpha/textured topology, exact3/4 detailed subset, repeat/reverse-order identity/ordinal equality and shadow selector stability/distribution.
Existing32-shoot fixture retains one coarse sample per shoot, deterministic order and ordinal spatial spread.

Existing asset decodes6 bakes; current site/runtime variant/species source hash matches all4 playable LODs plus both oak/beech vista bakes. Native coordinates/radii/leaf geometry bits remain fingerprint inputs.

optional_related_asset_receiver.reason: If cloud pairs are refreshed, existing case checks both raw fixture digests, complete byte length and nonempty payload; no full ray-by-ray or rendered equivalence proof.

execution_constraints: Use native Windows target at the exact final source+artifact commit, keeping identical expected assets and assertions used for Linux.
Do not set FABELGEIST_UPDATE_GARDEN_SPECIMEN, do not use ignored exporter cases as acceptance, and do not introduce platform-specific snapshots/thresholds/fallback.
Record source revision and real nonempty successful case counts; existing result-cell guards can distinguish a genuine run from an empty filtered run.
No local execution was performed by reviewer. Corrected export and later Linux/Windows authoritative results remain root-owned and pending.
These cases cover only their current authored species/seeds/sites; no renderer/browser, all-seed, all-platform or full774 clearance.
